battle_presentation.role: presentation/data binding only; it must not replace the stock battle/session/result authority

forbidden_ownership: one Blueprint child per slime variant
direct save-file mutation from enemy content
required_live_relationships: BP_MelodiaEnemy_SingleStock resolves its stock parent/adapter contract.
The encounter references the Melodia enemy adapter and the stock battle bridge.
The enemy adapter resolves a row from DT_MelodySlime_Enemies.
BP_MelodySlimeBattle is the battle-side presentation for the selected row.
Adding a fourth variant changes data rows/references only; no authority or Blueprint fork changes.

proof_variants.proof_intent: A readable low-complexity Forte row with one data-selected chart and modifier.
A Tide row proves the encounter is not coupled to one element or one chart.
A Gale row proves a third data-only variant without a new authority.

allowed_changes: Add or select one row in DT_MelodySlime_Enemies.
Reference existing rows in DT_MelodySlime_Skills and DT_MelodySlime_RoomMods, or add data rows to those tables when the content requires them.
forbidden_changes: Create or fork an enemy battle authority.
Add a map-specific branch for the variant.
Write variant state directly to a save object.

live_evidence_required: The three source tables are imported as DataTables with the declared row structures.
The selected row, skill rows, and room-mod rows resolve through live reflection.
BP_MelodiaEnemy_SingleStock parent/CDO and encounter reference are read back.
BP_MelodySlimeBattle is located and its presentation role is read back.
One fourth-row dry-run or live data-only proof shows no new Blueprint/authority mutation.
Compile/save/mtime/readback and a stock battle result are verified in a later live lane.
offline_blockers: No DT_MelodySlime_* .uasset import is present in the current source-row audit.
BP_MelodySlimeBattle has no stable source path in the repository contract and needs live registry resolution.
Parent, CDO, encounter reference, and stock battle handoff are not proven by JSON rows.
Static row validation cannot prove battle presentation, map placement, or PIE behavior.
